# plural_service_deployment (Data Source)

Service deployment data source. Looks up a service deployment by the handle of its cluster and its name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) Handle of the cluster this service deployment is deployed to, e.g. `mgmt`.
- `name` (String) Name of this service deployment, e.g. `console`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal identifier of this service deployment.
